articles.title: Ransomware Gangs Threaten Employees’ Families as AI-Powered Attacks Escalate
articles.summary:

articles.title: Google Pays $250,000 for AI-Assisted Chrome Exploit Enabling Windows Code Execution
articles.summary:
Google has awarded XBOW $250,000 for creating an AI-assisted exploit chain that enabled code execution outside the Chrome browser’s renderer sandbox on Windows. This reward marks the first full-chain payout for Chrome under Google’s vulnerability reward program, introduced in April 2026. articles.title: Meta GitHub Repositories Compromised, Exposing Software Code and Employee Personal Data
articles.summary:

The company began notifying affected individuals on October 13, after discovering the intrusion several weeks earlier, which involved the theft of an employee’s credentials. articles.title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 Flaw Enables Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
